structured_output.what_is_happening: "bluebirds" (birds) is a pump.fun coin that left the bonding curve about 2 minutes after launch, which is unusually fast and suggests heavy early buying. It is now 33 minutes old on PumpSwap. At detection its market cap was about $100k with $27k of liquidity, about 5.5x h1 turnover and a +100–196% move over the hour. It is about 33% below its $151k all-time high. The dev has sold out ('creator_close'). The data sources disagree sharply. DexScreener reports 4,182 buys against 235 sells in the last 5 minutes. GeckoTerminal reports only 79 buys from 69 unique buyers in the same window, and GeckoTerminal shows more sells than buys over m15 and m30. Holder counts also disagree: 4,401 (RugCheck) vs 693 (GMGN) vs 107 (GeckoTerminal). Together this points to micro-buy bot spam inflating transaction and holder counts. Structure looks clean: mint and freeze authority renounced, LP burned, top10 holders at 15.6%, RugCheck score 1. On the other side, GMGN flags a 53% 'entrapment' trader share, 10 bundlers, 16 snipers and 33 fresh wallets.
